description: Impianti di produzione di energia da fonti rinnovabili - puntuale is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by eds.cittametropolitana.torino.it. Timely location of plants for the production of energy from renewable sources authorised pursuant to Legislative Decree No 387/2003. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Plants for the production of energy from renewable sources - punctual" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include torino, RNDT. The listing shows 2024-05-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/conditionsUnknown). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
